name: insumer
description: InsumerAPI wallet auth: condition-based access for blockchain wallets. Get an API key, attest wallet conditions (token balances across 37 chains, plus NFT ownership, EAS attestations, Farcaster IDs and account code state (plain key, EIP-7702 delegation or contract) where supported), pull signed wallet trust profiles, get token-holder discounts at InsumerAPI merchants, and verify every signed response offline against the public JWKS.
